chapter_title.ar: باب مَوْلِدِ النَّبِيِّ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) وَ وَفَاتِهِ
chapter_title.en: Chapter 111 – Nazool (Arrival) of the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> and his<sup>saww</sup> demise

gradings: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (5/225)

translations.bn: আমাদের কয়েকজন সঙ্গী আহমদ ইবন মুহাম্মদ থেকে, তিনি আল-হুসাইন ইবন সাঈদ থেকে, তিনি মুহাম্মদ ইবন সিনান থেকে, তিনি ইবন মুসকান থেকে, তিনি ইসমাঈল ইবন ‘আম্মার থেকে, তিনি আবু ‘আবদিল্লাহ عليه السلام থেকে বর্ণনা করেছেন, যিনি বলেছেন:
translations.de: Eine Anzahl unserer Gefährten überlieferte von Ahmad ibn Muhammad, von al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, von Muhammad ibn Sinan, von Ibn Muskan, von Isma‘il ibn ‘Ammar, von Abu ‘Abdillah عليه السلام, der sagte:
translations.en: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Isma‘il ibn ‘Ammar, from Abu ‘Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
translations.es: Un grupo de nuestros compañeros, de Ahmad ibn Muhammad, de al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, de Muhammad ibn Sinan, de Ibn Muskan, de Isma‘il ibn ‘Ammar, de Abu ‘Abdillah عليه السلام, quien dijo:
translations.fa: تعدادی از اصحاب ما، از احمد بن محمد، از حسین بن سعید، از محمد بن سنان، از ابن مسکان، از اسماعیل بن عمار، از ابو عبدالله علیه السلام روایت کردند که فرمود:
translations.fr: Un groupe de nos compagnons, d’Ahmad ibn Muhammad, d’al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, de Muhammad ibn Sinan, d’Ibn Muskan, d’Isma‘il ibn ‘Ammar, d’Abu ‘Abdillah عليه السلام, qui a dit :
translations.id: Sejumlah sahabat kami, dari Ahmad ibn Muhammad, dari al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, dari Muhammad ibn Sinan, dari Ibn Muskan, dari Isma‘il ibn ‘Ammar, dari Abu ‘Abdillah عليه السلام, yang berkata:
translations.ru: Некоторые из наших сподвижников передали от Ahmad ibn Muhammad, от al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, от Muhammad ibn Sinan, от Ibn Muskan, от Isma‘il ibn ‘Ammar, от Abu ‘Abdillah عليه السلام, который сказал:
translations.tr: Ashabımızdan bir grup, Ahmad ibn Muhammad’den, o da al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id’den, o da Muhammad ibn Sinan’dan, o da Ibn Muskan’dan, o da Isma‘il ibn ‘Ammar’dan, o da Abu ‘Abdillah عليه السلام’dan rivayet etti ki şöyle dedi:
translations.ur: ہمارے چند اصحاب نے، احمد بن محمد سے، انہوں نے حسین بن سعید سے، انہوں نے محمد بن سنان سے، انہوں نے ابن مسکان سے، انہوں نے اسماعیل بن عمار سے، انہوں نے ابو عبداللہ علیہ السلام سے روایت کی، جنہوں نے فرمایا:
translations.zh: 我们的一些同伴传述自AhmadibnMuhammad，传自al-HusaynibnSa‘id，传自MuhammadibnSinan，传自IbnMuskan，传自Isma‘ilibn‘Ammar，传自Abu‘Abdillah عليه السلام，他说：

translations.bn: অন্ধকার রাতে রাসূলুল্লাহ صلى الله عليه وآله-কে দেখা গেলে, তাঁর জন্য একটি আলো দেখা যেত, যেন তা চাঁদের একটি অংশ।
translations.de: Wenn der Gesandte Allahs صلى الله عليه وآله in der dunklen Nacht gesehen wurde, sah man für ihn ein Licht, als wäre es ein Stück des Mondes.
translations.en: When the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله was seen in the dark night, a light was seen for him, as though it were a portion of the moon.
translations.es: Cuando se veía al Mensajero de Allah صلى الله عليه وآله en la noche oscura, se veía para él una luz, como si fuera una porción de la luna.
translations.fa: هرگاه رسول خدا صلى الله عليه وآله در شب تاریک دیده می‌شد، برای او نوری دیده می‌شد، گویی پاره‌ای از ماه بود.
translations.fr: Lorsque le Messager d’Allah صلى الله عليه وآله était vu dans la nuit obscure, on voyait pour lui une lumière, comme s’il s’agissait d’une portion de la lune.
translations.id: Ketika Rasulullah صلى الله عليه وآله terlihat pada malam yang gelap, terlihat cahaya untuk beliau, seakan-akan itu adalah sepotong bulan.
translations.ru: Когда Посланника Аллаха صلى الله عليه وآله видели в темную ночь, для него видели свет, словно это был кусок луны.
translations.tr: Allah’ın Resulü صلى الله عليه وآله karanlık gecede görüldüğünde, onun için bir nur görülürdü; sanki ayın bir parçasıymış gibi.
translations.ur: جب رسول اللہ صلى الله عليه وآله کو تاریک رات میں دیکھا جاتا، تو ان کے لیے ایک نور دیکھا جاتا، گویا وہ چاند کا ایک ٹکڑا ہو۔
translations.zh: 当人们在黑夜中看见真主的使者 صلى الله عليه وآله时，会看见他周围有一道光，仿佛是一片月亮。

en.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, referring to Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله
en.شِقَّةُ قَمَرٍ: a portion or piece of the moon, expressing the likeness of the light

seo_questions.bn: অন্ধকার রাতে নবী صلى الله عليه وآله-এর আলো সম্পর্কে আল-কাফি কী বর্ণনা করে?
seo_questions.de: Was berichtet al-Kafi über das Licht des Propheten صلى الله عليه وآله in der Dunkelheit der Nacht?
seo_questions.en: What does al-Kafi narrate about the light of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله in the darkness of night?
seo_questions.es: ¿Qué narra al-Kafi acerca de la luz del Profeta صلى الله عليه وآله en la oscuridad de la noche?
seo_questions.fa: الکافی درباره نور پیامبر صلى الله عليه وآله در تاریکی شب چه روایت می‌کند؟
seo_questions.fr: Que rapporte al-Kafi au sujet de la lumière du Prophète صلى الله عليه وآله dans l’obscurité de la nuit ?
seo_questions.id: Apa yang dinarasikan al-Kafi tentang cahaya Nabi صلى الله عليه وآله dalam kegelapan malam?
seo_questions.ru: Что передает аль-Кафи о свете Пророка صلى الله عليه وآله в темноте ночи?
seo_questions.tr: el-Kâfî, gecenin karanlığında Peygamber صلى الله عليه وآله’in nuru hakkında ne rivayet eder?
seo_questions.ur: الکافی رسول اللہ صلى الله عليه وآله کی رات کی تاریکی میں روشنی کے بارے میں کیا روایت کرتا ہے؟
seo_questions.zh: 《卡菲》关于先知 صلى الله عليه وآله在黑夜中的光有什么记述？

summaries.bn: এই হাদিসে অন্ধকার রাতের মধ্যে রাসূলুল্লাহ صلى الله عليه وآله-এর সঙ্গে সম্পর্কিত একটি আলোকময় নিদর্শনের বর্ণনা রয়েছে। এতে তাঁর দীপ্তিময় উপস্থিতির কথা বলা হয়েছে, যেখানে তাঁর চারপাশে চাঁদের একটি অংশের মতো দৃশ্যমান আলো দেখা যেত।
summaries.de: Dieser Hadith beschreibt ein leuchtendes Zeichen, das mit dem Gesandten Allahs صلى الله عليه وآله in der Dunkelheit der Nacht verbunden ist. Er schildert seine strahlende Gegenwart und stellt ein sichtbares Licht um ihn herum dar, wie ein Stück des Mondes.
summaries.en: This hadith describes a luminous sign associated with the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله in the darkness of night. It presents a report of his radiant presence, portraying a visible light around him like a piece of the moon.
summaries.es: Este hadiz describe una señal luminosa asociada con el Mensajero de Allah صلى الله عليه وآله en la oscuridad de la noche. Presenta un relato de su presencia radiante, retratando una luz visible a su alrededor como un trozo de la luna.
summaries.fa: این حدیث نشانه‌ای نورانی را که با رسول خدا صلى الله عليه وآله در تاریکی شب همراه بوده، توصیف می‌کند. این روایت از حضور درخشان ایشان سخن می‌گوید و نوری را که پیرامون ایشان مانند پاره‌ای از ماه دیده می‌شد، به تصویر می‌کشد.
summaries.fr: Ce hadith décrit un signe lumineux associé au Messager d’Allah صلى الله عليه وآله dans l’obscurité de la nuit. Il présente un récit de sa présence rayonnante, dépeignant une lumière visible autour de lui comme un morceau de la lune.
summaries.id: Hadis ini menggambarkan sebuah tanda bercahaya yang dikaitkan dengan Rasulullah صلى الله عليه وآله dalam kegelapan malam. Riwayat ini menampilkan kehadiran beliau yang bercahaya, dengan cahaya yang tampak di sekeliling beliau seperti sepotong bulan.
summaries.ru: Этот хадис описывает светозарный знак, связанный с Посланником Аллаха صلى الله عليه وآله в темноте ночи. В нем передается рассказ о его сияющем присутствии, когда вокруг него был виден свет, словно это был кусок луны.
summaries.tr: Bu hadis, gecenin karanlığında Allah’ın Resulü صلى الله عليه وآله ile ilişkilendirilen nurani bir alameti anlatır. Onun parlak varlığını aktarır ve etrafında ayın bir parçası gibi görünen bir ışığı tasvir eder.
summaries.ur: یہ حدیث تاریک رات میں رسول اللہ صلى الله عليه وآله کے ساتھ منسوب ایک نورانی علامت کو بیان کرتی ہے۔ اس میں آپ کی روشن موجودگی کا ذکر ہے، جس میں آپ کے گرد چاند کے ایک ٹکڑے جیسی نظر آنے والی روشنی بیان کی گئی ہے۔
summaries.zh: 这段圣训描述了在黑夜中与真主的使者 صلى الله عليه وآله相关的一种光明迹象。它呈现了他光辉临在的记述，描绘出他周围可见一道光，仿佛是一片月亮。

gradings: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (5/225)
text: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) إِذَا رُئِيَ فِي اللَّيْلَةِ الظَّلْمَاءِ رُئِيَ لَهُ نُورٌ كَأَنَّهُ شِقَّةُ قَمَرٍ .

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Ismail Bin Ammar,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘It was so that whenever Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> was looked at in the dark night, there was seen to be a ‘نُورٌ’ Light for him<sup>saww</sup> as if it was a portion of the moon’.
en.sarwar: 19. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Asha‘ari has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from Mansur ibn al-‘Abbass from Ali ibn Asbat from Ya’qub ibn Salim from a man from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following. “When the Messenger of Allah passed away the family of Muhammad (s.a.) experienced the longest night. They thought there is no sky to provide them shadow or earth to hold them up. The Messenger of Allah had united all people just for the sake of Allah. In such a condition sommeone came to them whom they would not see but would hear his words. He offered them greetings say, “Peace be with you, O members of the family of the Holy Prophet (s.a.) and may Allah’s mercy and blessings be with you. With Allah is the best of condolences for all kinds of suffering and the salvation from all forms of destruction and a remedy for the losses.. He then read the words of Allah “Every soul is destined to experience the agony of death. You (Muslims) will receive the recompense for your deeds on the Day of Judgment. To be saved from the fire and admitted to Paradise is certainly a great triumph. The worldly life is no more than a deceitful possession.” [3:185] He the continued, “Allah hass selected you, granted you distinction, purified, and made members of the family of His prophet. He has entrusted you with His knowledge and has made you to inherit His book He has made you the chest (ark) of His knowledge and the staff of His Majesty. He has given for an example of His light and has protected you from all sins and mistakes. He has protected you against all forms of mischief. Accept the condolences of Allah. Allah has not withdrawn His blessings away from you and He will never remove any of His bounties from you. You are the people of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Gracious, through whom the bounties increase, different groups become united and words receive harmony. You are His friends Those who would love you they achieve success and those who has said the following would do injustice to you will banish.To love you is obligatory because of the commands of Allah in His book on His believing servants. Besides, Allah is full power to help and support whenever He would wish. Exercise patience against the consequences of the matters because they all proceed to Allah.. Allah has accepted you as the Holy Prophet (s.a.) has entrusted you with Him and He has entrusted you with to His faithful friends on earth. Whoever would be truthful to the trust with him Allah will give him the reward for his truthfulness. You are the entrusted trust and to love you is made obligatory on people and obedience to you is a duty. Allah has taken His Messenger away from this world and He has completed the religion for you. He has explained to you how to come out of (difficulties). He has not left any excuse for any one. Whoever, would not know or pretend to be ignorant, deny, forget or pretend to forget will be held accountable before Allah. Allah will always pursue to fulfill your needs. I entrust you with Allah. May peace and blessings be with you.” The narrator has said that then he asked the Imam (a.s.), “ From who did the condolences came?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “It came from Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High.”
